data.name: Shanghai HaiQi Environmental Technology
data.description: Shanghai Haiqi Environmental Protection Technology is a Chinese biomass gasification and pyrolysis equipment manufacturer founded in 1995, headquartered in Pudong, Shanghai. Its core business is selling gasifiers, waste-to-energy systems, and carbonization/pyrolysis units to industrial customers globally (Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, France, etc.), with biochar produced as a co-product. The company recently rebranded toward "negative carbon CDR" marketing and references Puro.earth approval of its pyrolysis equipment.
